name: ARIA Malaysia business applicability
description: Controlled operational terms for explaining which Malaysian business profiles may need to review a confirmed regulatory change.
disclaimer: This ARIA-maintained vocabulary is not an official legal classification and does not determine whether an organization is legally regulated.

terms.label: Malaysia
terms.description: Organizations, operations, or regulated activity connected to Malaysia.

terms.label: Cross-sector
terms.description: Requirements that are not limited to a named industry sector.

terms.label: Financial services
terms.description: Banking, insurance, payments, capital-market, and related financial services.

terms.label: Digital services
terms.description: Online platforms, software, data, and internet-delivered services.

terms.label: Healthcare
terms.description: Healthcare providers, health services, and related operations.

terms.label: Education
terms.description: Education providers and learning services.

terms.label: Retail and e-commerce
terms.description: Physical or online sale of goods and consumer services.

terms.label: Telecommunications
terms.description: Electronic communications networks and services.

terms.label: Professional services
terms.description: Advisory, legal, accounting, consulting, and comparable services.

terms.label: Manufacturing
terms.description: Production, assembly, and industrial operations.

terms.label: Public sector
terms.description: Government departments, agencies, statutory bodies, and public services.

terms.label: Company
terms.description: A company or other incorporated commercial organization.

terms.label: Public body
terms.description: A government entity, statutory body, or other public authority.

terms.label: Non-profit organization
terms.description: A charity, society, foundation, or other non-profit organization.

terms.label: Data user
terms.description: An organization acting in the data-user role described by Malaysian personal-data material.

terms.label: Data processor
terms.description: An organization processing personal data for another organization.

terms.label: Employer
terms.description: An organization acting as an employer.

terms.label: Service provider
terms.description: An organization supplying services to another person or organization.

terms.label: Processes personal data
terms.description: Collects, records, stores, uses, discloses, or otherwise processes personal data.

terms.label: Conducts direct marketing
terms.description: Uses contact or personal information for direct marketing activity.

terms.label: Transfers data across borders
terms.description: Transfers or makes personal data available outside Malaysia.

terms.label: Employs workers
terms.description: Engages employees or other workers.

terms.label: Operates a digital service
terms.description: Provides or operates software, an online platform, or another digital service.

terms.label: Micro organization
terms.description: Profile declares itself in its applicable micro-size category.

terms.label: Small organization
terms.description: Profile declares itself in its applicable small-size category.

terms.label: Medium organization
terms.description: Profile declares itself in its applicable medium-size category.

terms.label: Large organization
terms.description: Profile declares itself in its applicable large-size category.

terms.label: Any organization size
terms.description: The candidate is not limited to a particular organization size.
